issue: गए तुम गिरिजा के पास । बोले कहां नारी विश्वास: each half is two mātrās short, and it is Śiva, not Gaṇeśa (तुम), who goes to Girijā; a word may be lost (e.g. शम्भु for तुम, पासा / विश्वासा). No independent copy found.
our reading: (Śiva) went to Girijā and said: where is a wife's faithfulness?
alternatives: गए शम्भु गिरिजा के पासा । बोले कहाँ नारि विश्वासा (a guess, not attested).

issue: साई दिवस से तुम जग वन्दित: साई is unclear; perhaps सोई ('that very') day.
our reading: From that day you are worshipped by the world.

issue: डासना पी नित कृपा तुम्हारी: डासना is probably the town Ḍāsnā (Ghaziabad), the poet's place or a Gaṇeśa shrine; पी is unclear (पै 'on'?). It may also be a slip for दासन पर ('on your servants').
our reading: May your grace be always on Ḍāsnā.
alternatives: दासन पर नित कृपा तुम्हारी ('your grace always on your servants').

issue: सो छिन में यही अवसर अइहै । प्रकट सफल सन्देह मिटाइहै: the subject (सो: she, the mother, or 'so') and सफल ('fruitful', perhaps a slip for सकल 'all') are open.
our reading: She will come in a moment, at this very time, and appearing, she will clear away the doubt to good effect.
alternatives: सो = 'so': 'So in a moment this very occasion will come…'; सफल a slip for सकल: 'will clear away all doubt'.

issue: पृथ्वी प्रदक्षिणा दोउ दीन्ही: प्रदक्षिणा देना is also 'to circumambulate', which would say both went round the earth; the story (chaupāīs 35–37) has only Ṣaḍānana go.
our reading: The two of you were given the circling of the earth (as a task).
alternatives: Both of you set out to circle the earth.

issue: उनके तुम साथी गौरीसा: गौरीसा (Gaurīśa) is ordinarily Śiva, Gaurī's lord, but the chālīsā addresses Gaṇeśa; it may be a rhyme-form vocative to Gaṇeśa (Gaurī's own), or 'you and Gaurīśa are their companions'.
our reading: You are their companion, O Gaurīśa (a vocative, as the words stand).
alternatives: Addressed to Gaṇeśa as son of Gaurī; or Śiva named beside him as companion.
